NONE: A1 a large amount or to a large degree
多（的），大量（的）
› a far larger amount of something than you want or need
太多
A2 more than someone can deal with
多得不能應付
› too extreme or not reasonable
太過分，太不像話
› UK informal humorous used at the end of a sentence to emphasize what you have just said
（用在否定句末表示相反的意思）
C1 (something) of good quality
優秀的事物；了不起，十分出色

example: I don't earn much money.
我賺錢不多。
You haven't said much, Joan - what do you think?
你說得不多，瓊——你怎麼想？
I like her very much.
我非常喜歡她。
I don't think there's much to be gained by catching an earlier flight.
我認為趕更早的航班沒甚麼好處。
The children never eat (very) much, but they seem healthy.
孩子都吃得不多，但他們看來很健康。
"Is there any wine left?" "Not much."
「還有酒嗎？」「不多了。」
There's not/nothing much to do around here.
這裡沒太多事可以做。
How much (= what amount of) sugar do you take in your coffee?
你的咖啡裡要放多少糖？
How much do these shoes cost?
這雙鞋子多少錢？
I spend too much on clothes.
我在衣服上花費太多了。
I don't have as much time as (= I have less time than) I would like for visiting my friends.
我沒有足夠的時間拜訪朋友。
Because of the rain, we weren't able to spend much of the day on the beach.
因為下雨，那天我們未能在海灘上停留很久。
Have you seen much of Polly (= often seen her) recently?
你最近常見到波莉／聽到波莉的消息嗎？
I'd very much like to visit them sometime.
我真想找個時間去拜訪他們。
One day I hope I'll be able to do as much (= the same amount) for you as you've done for me.
希望有一天我能報答你。
Things around here are much as always/as usual (= have not changed a lot).
這裡的情況沒甚麼變化。
The two schools are much the same (= very similar).
這兩所學校非常相似。
Much to our surprise, (= we were very surprised that) they accepted our offer.
令我們大為驚訝的是，他們接受了我們的出價。
I'm not much good at knitting (= do not do it very well).
我不太擅長編織。
This is a much (= often) discussed issue.
這是個人們經常討論的問題。
Blake has become a much (= greatly) changed person since his car accident.
遭遇車禍後，布賴克好像變成了另一個人。
I've been feeling much healthier (= a lot more healthy) since I became a vegetarian.
自從開始吃素後，我感覺健康多了。
The repairs to our car cost much more than we were expecting.
修車費比我們預料的貴得多。
I'm very much aware of the problem.
我很清楚這個問題。
She's much the best person for the job (= she is certainly better than everyone else).
她無疑是這個職位的最佳人選。
I would much rather have my baby at home than in hospital.
我寧願在家中生孩子，而不是去醫院。
She is as much a friend to me as a mother (= although she is my mother, she is also a friend).
她既是我的母親，又是我的朋友。
You've drunk much too much to drive.
你喝得實在太多了，不能駕車。
I can't take care of six children at my age - it's too much.
我這個年紀照顧不了六個孩子——太多了。
I think it's a bit much for you to expect me to do all the cleaning.
你竟然想我做所有的打掃工作——你是不是太過分了。
She wore an expensive suit and diamonds, which was a bit much for such a casual restaurant.
她身穿昂貴的外套，戴著鑽石首飾，在這樣隨意的餐館顯得過分了。
When he saw all the food on my plate, he said "Hungry much?"
當他看到我盤子裡滿滿的食物時，問道：不餓了吧？
He's not much to look at, but he has a wonderful personality.
他長相不怎麼好看，但性格很好。
I've never been much of a dancer (= good at dancing, or interested in doing it).
我對舞蹈從不在行。
There's not/nothing much on TV tonight.
今晚電視上沒甚麼好看的。

NONE: › although
雖然，即使

example: Much as I would like to help you, I'm simply too busy at the moment.
雖然我很想幫你，但恐怕現在我太忙了。

NONE: › and certainly not
更不用說，更何況

example: Tony can barely boil an egg, much less cook dinner.
托尼連雞蛋都煮不好，更別提煮晚餐了。

NONE: › used to make a negative statement stronger
更不用說，更別提

example: At the age of 14 I had never even been on a train, much less an aircraft.
我14歲時還從未坐過火車，更不用說飛機了。

NONE: › to be very similar and usually of low quality
很相像，差不多

example: The songs you hear on the radio these days all sound much of a muchness.
如今，電台播放的歌曲都大同小異。

NONE: › mud, dirt, or a sticky natural substance such as animal waste
髒東西；（動物的）糞便
› UK something you consider very unpleasant or very low quality
品質低劣的東西

example: There was green muck at the bottom of the boat.
船底有綠色的髒東西。
You're treading muck into the carpet with your dirty shoes!
你的髒鞋子把地毯弄得髒兮兮的！
a pile of dog muck
一堆狗屎
I'm not eating that muck!
我才不吃那讓人反胃的東西！
The immigrants were treated like muck (= treated badly, as if they were not important).
移民都被視為泥土草芥。

NONE: › to clean a place where a large animal lives, especially a stable, by removing the waste products and old straw
打掃（畜舍）

example: She'd spent all morning mucking out the horses.
她整個上午都在打掃馬廄。

NONE: › to share the work that needs to be done
一起出力，一起合作；參加

example: She doesn't mind mucking in with the rest of us when there's work to be done.
有工作要做的時候，她不介意和我們大家一起做。

NONE: › to behave in a silly way, or to treat someone or something in a careless way
胡鬧；耍弄；瞎弄

example: Stop mucking about with those ornaments, you'll break something!
別亂碰那些擺設了，你早晚會打碎的！
I'm fed up with them mucking me about and cancelling our arrangements.
他們耍弄我，取消了我們的安排——我受夠了。

NONE: › to spoil something completely, or do something very badly
打亂；把…弄糟

example: I really prepared for the interview because I didn't want to muck it up.
我確實為面試做了準備，因為我不想出甚麼岔子。
I mucked up the whole test!
我考試考得一塌糊塗！

NONE: › a mistake that completely spoils something
把事情搞糟

example: They made a muck-up of our order - it won't be ready till next week now.
他們搞亂了我們的訂單——現在要等到下周才能準備好。

NONE: › the activity, especially by newspapers and reporters, of trying to find out unpleasant information about people or organizations in order to make it public
（尤指報紙和記者）搜集並揭露醜聞

example: There was so much muckraking about his family life that he decided not to stand for election.
眾多媒體大肆搜集消息來報道他的家庭生活，致使他決定不參加競選。

NONE: › informal dirty
髒的，骯髒的
› UK informal related to or describing sex in an offensive way
淫穢作品；色情書刊（或電影等）

example: Get your mucky feet off that chair!
把你的髒腳從椅子上拿開！
Don't walk all over my clean floor in your mucky boots.
別穿著你的髒靴子在我乾淨的地板上到處走。
a mucky magazine
淫穢雜誌

NONE: › the thin skin that covers the inside surface of parts of the body such as the nose and mouth and produces mucus to protect them
粘膜

example: gastric mucosa
胃粘膜
oral mucosa
口腔粘膜

NONE: › relating to the mucosa (= the thin skin that covers the inside surface of parts of the body such as the nose and mouth and produces mucus to protect them)
粘膜的
› relating to mucus (= a slippery lubricant and protective substance)
粘液的
› the thin skin that covers the inside surface of parts of the body such as the nose and mouth and produces mucus to protect them
粘膜
› a thick liquid produced inside the nose and other parts of the body
（粘膜分泌的）粘液

example: This drug reduces mucus production in the gut.
這種藥可以減少腸道的粘液分泌。
